explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and nonzero only at D2 on trials where the agent chose a2 and the previous trial went unrewarded; it is always 0 after a rewarded trial or when the agent chose a1. The first unrewarded trial after a reward gives about 5-7, and two or more unrewarded trials in a row while still choosing a2 give about 10, whether the transition was common or rare.
